allow_instructions: Creating, editing and saving ordinary project source, tests, documentation and backlog files inside the open Aqil workspace is allowed.
The same ordinary edits are allowed inside an assigned Git worktree of this repository when that worktree is the agent workspace.
Read-only Git inspection and local test, typecheck, lint and build commands inside the workspace or that assigned worktree are allowed.
block_instructions: Pushing, deploying, or changing production, including git push, Vercel deploy, and updates to GitHub main, must wait for approval.
Hosted database changes, including supabase db push, remote migrations, and hosted SQL that writes or changes schema, must wait for approval.
Changes to credentials, environment files, OAuth tokens, token vaults, or secret configuration must wait for approval.
Deleting financial archives, apps/web/.local, secrets, or sensitive configuration must wait for approval.
Destructive Git operations, including reset --hard, clean, force push, and deleting branches that are not confirmed merged, must wait for approval.
